method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING, with a NOTHING-kind tag, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (beginning within the time another place's limitation law allows, made part of the law applied by s 56 and applied to revenue actions by s 54) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 1985 (ACT), A1985-66, Republication No 28 (R28), effective 26 November 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1985-66.txt; Division 4.4 and s 54 as inserted by A1993-82 s 6 (commenced 30 November 1993), s 54 as amended by A2006-42; s 21BC as inserted by A2021-15

seat: the person bringing a claim: the claimant whose claim is before a court of the ACT or an arbitrator and is governed by the law of an Australian State, another Territory or New Zealand, or who sues another State or Territory in the ACT to recover a tax, licence fee or duty (clact-claims.l4)
focus: choice of law: the ACT counterpart of the Choice of Law (Limitation Periods) Acts (the provisions a claimant meets)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run clact-dates.l4 ; l4 run clact-claims.l4 ; l4 run clact-cases.l4
checks.result: 62 assertions written, 62 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Choice of law only. In: Division 4.4 whole (s 55 definitions, s 56 characterisation of limitation laws, s 57 exercise of discretion under limitation law), s 54 (recovery of State or Territory revenue amounts), s 21BC (3) (b) with (1), (2). Out: Parts 1 to 3 and Divisions 4.1 to 4.3 apart from s 54 (the Act's own time limits, for the baseline beside this one), s 21A (3), Division 4.5 (machinery), the other places' limitation laws (their last day asked as a fact). Reasons in NOTES.md.
